description: Recorded reasons for unverified items that exist only when a resident runtime is staged (PACKAGED). Read in addition to unverified-allowlist.json only then. This file gates nothing (owner decision P-09); a reason is a record, not legal sign-off.

entries.name: Node.js embedded runtime (libeliza_node.so)
entries.reason: The packaged Android resident runtime embeds Node.js (MIT) with bundled native dependencies (V8, libuv, OpenSSL, ICU, zlib, c-ares, nghttp2). Individual embedded library notices are tracked upstream in @elizaos/os.
